sources.source: DBS annual report and accounts: 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report was published on 16 July 2026 and summarises Disclosure and Barring Service activities and audited financial statements for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds safer-recruitment and barring-system governance context while retaining application-versus-person, disclosure-versus-barring, service-volume, decision, reporting-year and corporate-activity-versus-safeguarding-outcome guards.

sources.source: Professional Standards Authority: annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Professional Standards Authority for Health and Social Care
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 8 July 2026 covers PSA performance and activities to protect the public by improving regulation and registration of health and care professionals across the UK, together with audited accounts.
sources.quality_effect: Adds professional-regulation assurance context while retaining regulator-versus-register, review-versus-enforcement, UK-wide scope, performance-output and no-clinical-harm-prevalence guards.

sources.source: Patient Safety Commissioner annual report 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Department of Health and Social Care and Patient Safety Commissioner
sources.verified_fact: The independent report published on 13 July 2026 summarises the work of the Patient Safety Commissioner during the 2025 to 2026 financial year for stakeholders interested in patient safety.
sources.quality_effect: Adds independent patient-safety advocacy and system-learning context while retaining recommendation-versus-implementation, activity-versus-harm, reporting-year and no-provider-level incidence guards.

sources.source: NHS Resolution annual report and accounts: 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 9 July 2026 covers NHS Resolution performance, accountability and financial statements for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds indemnity, claims and resolution-system context while retaining claim-versus-incident, payment timing, scheme scope, legal outcome, reporting-year and no-direct-clinical-risk guards.

sources.source: NHS Counter Fraud Authority annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The annual report published on 16 July 2026 sets out NHSCFA performance and use of resources for the financial year 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds health-system fraud-control context while retaining detected-versus-undetected loss, allegation-versus-case, prevention-versus-recovery, resource-use and no-patient-safety-incidence guards.

sources.source: Health Research Authority annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 9 July 2026 explains HRA achievements and challenges during 2025 to 2026 and contains performance, accountability and financial reporting sections.
sources.quality_effect: Adds research-governance and ethics-review context while retaining application-versus-study, approval-versus-conduct, oversight-versus-outcome and reporting-year guards.

sources.source: HSE KPIs report for 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report updated on 29 April 2026 provides end-of-year quarterly outturn against HSE strategic KPIs for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and states that figures remain subject to evaluation and validation before the annual report.
sources.quality_effect: Adds regulator-performance context while retaining KPI-versus-harm, provisional-versus-validated, activity-versus-outcome, strategic-objective and no-workplace-incidence substitution guards.

sources.source: Defra's annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 15 July 2026 sets out progress against Defra priorities and outcomes alongside planned expenditure for April 2025 to March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds departmental resilience and environmental-governance context while retaining policy-priority-versus-delivery, expenditure-versus-outcome, group-body scope and no-local-hazard measurement guards.

sources.source: OEP's annual report and accounts for 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The OEP report published on 9 July 2026 covers 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and was laid before Parliament and the Northern Ireland Assembly under the Environment Act 2021.
sources.quality_effect: Adds independent environmental-oversight context while retaining complaint-versus-investigation, advice-versus-enforcement, jurisdiction, annual activity and no-environmental-incident-prevalence guards.

sources.source: OGA/NSTA annual report and accounts, 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Oil and Gas Authority and North Sea Transition Authority
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 7 July 2026 covers NSTA activities, performance, accountability and finances for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026; OGA remains the legal company name while NSTA is the business name.
sources.quality_effect: Adds offshore-energy regulatory context while retaining legal-name-versus-business-name, regulatory-output, production, transition, decommissioning and no-incident-rate guards.

sources.source: Animal and Plant Health Agency annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The report updated on 6 May 2026 covers APHA performance and measures for 2024 to 2025 and identifies continuing improvement needs around specialist biocontainment, high-hazard biological-agent work, outbreak response and the regional laboratory network.
sources.quality_effect: Adds animal-health biosecurity and laboratory-resilience context while retaining audit-versus-incident, hazard-work-versus-release, outbreak-response, facility scope and reporting-period guards.

sources.source: Veterinary Medicines Directorate Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 30 June 2026 covers VMD performance and finances; the regulator reported 100% performance for national applications, inspections, import and export schemes and product-defect handling, with 22 of 38 published measures compliant 100% of the time.
sources.quality_effect: Adds veterinary-medicine regulatory performance context while retaining target-versus-safety-outcome, application, inspection, defect-report, scheme and no-adverse-event-prevalence guards.

sources.source: UKHSA Strategy 2026 to 2029
sources.verified_fact: The strategy published on 20 May 2026 sets three core service pillars—understand, prevent and respond—and supporting foundations for expertise, infrastructure, leadership and collaboration over the next three years.
sources.quality_effect: Adds health-security capability taxonomy while retaining strategy-versus-delivery, pillar-versus-metric, ambition-versus-outcome and no-current-threat-incidence guards.

sources.source: Health Security Risk Assessment (HSRA): 2025 Edition
sources.verified_fact: The first HSRA edition published on 11 June 2026 characterises selected significant health-security risks over five years using a systematic likelihood-and-impact framework for infectious diseases, environmental hazards and acute emergencies; its scenarios are planning tools rather than predictions.
sources.quality_effect: Adds structured preparedness-risk context while retaining scenario-versus-forecast, reasonable-worst-case, likelihood, impact, evolving-methodology and no-local-incidence guards.

sources.source: UKHSA safeguarding annual report 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 9 February 2026 records 135 safeguarding incidents in 2024 to 2025, a 22% increase in reports, and mandatory safeguarding training compliance rising from 67% to 83%; it links higher reporting partly to improved awareness and engagement.
sources.quality_effect: Adds organisational safeguarding-process context while retaining report-versus-harm, awareness-driven reporting, adult-versus-child, training-compliance, staff-contact scope and no-population-prevalence guards.

sources.source: Companies House annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report updated on 16 July 2026 describes Companies House work to improve register authority, prevent and disrupt economic crime, implement company-law reforms, modernise secure technology and strengthen data governance during 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds corporate-register integrity context while retaining company-versus-controller, suspicious-data-versus-proven-crime, prevention-versus-prosecution, register coverage and no-area-crime-rate guards.

sources.source: Insolvency Service Annual Report and Accounts 2025-2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 14 July 2026 records 78 money-laundering investigations and 55 enforcement outcomes in 2025 to 2026; Operation Hammerhead removed 11,500 companies after intelligence identified about 41,000 entities with suspected organised-crime links.
sources.quality_effect: Adds economic-crime enforcement context while retaining suspected-entity-versus-proven-offence, investigation-versus-outcome, company-versus-person, multi-agency attribution and no-local-prevalence guards.

sources.source: Home Office annual report and accounts: 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 14 July 2026 provides a financial and narrative summary of Home Office activities from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and is accompanied by core data tables.
sources.quality_effect: Adds departmental policing, borders and public-protection governance context while retaining programme-versus-outcome, expenditure-versus-harm, core-table definition and no-local-incidence guards.

sources.source: Information Commission annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 15 July 2026 accounts for Information Commission resource use and activity over the partial period 20 August 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds data-protection and information-rights regulatory context while retaining partial-period, complaint-versus-breach, enforcement-versus-compliance, activity-versus-incidence and organisation-scope guards.

sources.source: The Parole Board for England & Wales Annual Report 2025/26
sources.verified_fact: The report published on 14 July 2026 records 8,835 oral hearings, 12,528 prisoners refused release, 3,140 directed for release, 503 recommended for open conditions and 2,338 decision summaries issued during 2025 to 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds public-protection decision context while retaining hearing-versus-person, paper-versus-oral decision, refusal-versus-risk prevalence, open-condition recommendation, reporting-year and no-area-safety-score guards.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Annual reports describe governance, activity, finance and institutional performance rather than population harm prevalence.
Disclosure, registration, barring, professional regulation and patient-safety advocacy are distinct from measured safeguarding or clinical incidents.
Claims, fraud cases, investigations and enforcement outcomes depend on detection, scheme scope and reporting processes.
HSE KPI outturn is subject to evaluation and validation and cannot substitute for validated injury or illness statistics.
Defra, OEP and NSTA corporate reports provide governance context rather than local environmental or offshore hazard measures.
APHA and VMD reports describe biosecurity, laboratory and regulatory performance; audits and target compliance do not establish absence of incidents.
UKHSA strategy and HSRA scenarios support planning and preparedness; they are not delivered outcomes or predictions.
Higher UKHSA safeguarding reporting partly reflects awareness and process improvements and is not population prevalence.
Companies House suspicious activity, Insolvency Service investigations and enforcement outcomes use different units and evidential thresholds.
Information Commission reporting covers a partial financial-year period and regulatory activity is not breach incidence.
Parole hearings, refusals, releases and open-condition recommendations are distinct decision units and cannot be downscaled to parcels.
The uploaded 046 note remains non-canonical without matching task, heartbeat, claim and receipt evidence.
No existing candidate score, endpoint manifest or stored parcel value was modified.
